ladderRules.convexity: 1st=300 vs 9th-16th=20 - berths get you in, DEPTH gets points. A single quarterfinal (40) beats eight 17th-32nds.
ladderRules.ptwc1: League play to Aug 23 + PT Live/50 + weekly leaderboard to Aug 2 + PTCS 1-5 + PTMS 1-2 (PTCS 5 was the last input)
ladderRules.ptwc2: League play Aug 24 on + PT Live/50 + weekly leaderboard Aug 4-Jan 31 + PTCS 6-11 + PTMS 3-4 (everything scored now feeds this)
ladderRules.ptms: Top 128 of EACH cumulative PTCS standing (tournament + perfect draft) qualifies for the PTMS
ladderRules.capLiveNote: Cap and Live standings points are excluded from PTWC qualifying (no double-dipping); the PTCS Cap/Live EVENTS you actually played still count toward the PTMS tournament standing - unconfirmed, verify before relying on it.

forecastRule: No projection until a category has 3 scoring days; rates computed from each category's own first scoring day, not the period open.
